# Worker Handoff: Q101 Negative-Evidence Synthesis & Literature Frontier Review

## 1. Recurring Failure Signatures (from Q101 Atlas + Evidence Files)

| Failure Mode | Evidence | Recurrence |
|--------------|----------|------------|
| **Drawdown gate breach (≤10%)** | Q077R1 research 36.1%, holdout 15.6%; Q081R4 research 45.1%, holdout 24.1% | 3/3 drawdown gates (research, rolling, holdout) |
| **OOS fragility** | Holdout returns ~0.3-0.5× research returns across trials | Consistent across 7 trials |
| **Rolling-window instability** | Q077R1 windows: -7.9% to +76.8% returns; drawdowns 7-32% | High variance across 5 windows |
| **Control-relative failure** | Ensemble arms fail same gates as components | Suggests structural, not combinatorial, issue |
| **Turnover/cost pressure** | Implied by gross exposure enforcement incident (Q081R4: 1.0056 vs 1.0 cap) | Execution-level constraint |

**Key insight from Q102**: Rejected arms show *consensus directional behavior* in identifiable regimes:
- `DOWNTREND_HIGHVOL` → common **positive** mean daily return across arms
- `UPTREND_LOWVOL` → common **negative** mean daily return across arms
This suggests regime-conditioned *systematic error*, not random noise.

---

## 2. Literature-Inspired Mechanisms: Stress-Test & Confound Analysis

| Inspiration | Proposed Mechanism (Fixed, Public-Data) | Cheap Integrity Test | Confounds / Overlap | Discard If |
|-------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------|---------------------|------------|
| **State-dependent predictability** (Cong et al.) | Fixed regime descriptors: `(rolling_vol_63d > median) × (trend_252d < 0)` → `DOWNTREND_HIGHVOL`; `(rolling_vol_63d < median) × (trend_252d > 0)` → `UPTREND_LOWVOL`. Use as *conditioning context* for signal gating, not signal generation. | 1. Compute regime labels on full history (no holdout). 2. Check if Q102 consensus directions replicate. 3. Test if *any* existing signal has >55% directional accuracy in one regime and <45% in another (binomial test, p<0.05). | Overlaps Q102 regimes. Q082:C22-C25 may already encode similar state. | Regime labels require holdout optimization to "work"; or no signal shows regime-dependent skill beyond chance. |
| **Pure-news residual** (Didisheim et al.) | 1. Source: Public news corpus with stable IDs (e.g., GDELT, or SEC 8-K text). 2. Baseline: Regress news sentiment on lagged characteristics (size, value, momentum, sector) using expanding window. 3. Residual = actual - predicted sentiment. 4. Test residual as C31 input replacement. | 1. Verify PIT safety: baseline uses only t-1 characteristics. 2. Check residual autocorrelation <0.1 at 1-day lag. 3. Compare IC of raw vs residual sentiment on next-day returns (expanding window, no holdout selection). | C31 currently uses raw sentiment. Overlap if residual ≈ raw (low predictable component). | No public corpus with stable IDs + acceptance timestamps; or residual IC ≤ raw IC consistently. |
| **Shareholder experience** (Riley & Zhou) | Compute holder-weighted return `HWR_t = Σ_i (vol_{i,t} × ret_{i,t-τ:t}) / Σ_i vol_{i,t}` for τ ∈ {21, 63, 252}. Use as *state variable* (not signal): condition existing signals on `HWR` quintile. | 1. Compute from existing OHLCV (no new data). 2. Regress `HWR` on momentum (252d) — if R² > 0.8, it's momentum proxy. 3. Test if signal IC differs across `HWR` quintiles (interaction term, expanding window). | Q082:C22-C25 may already capture this. If `HWR` ≈ momentum, no new information. | `HWR` is momentum proxy (R² > 0.8); or no signal shows quintile-dependent IC. |
| **Risk-text peer propagation** (Yuan & Zhang) | 1. Parse 10-K Item 1A (risk factors) from SEC EDGAR (acceptance datetime). 2. TF-IDF cosine similarity → peer network. 3. Control: regress peer return on industry return; use residual as "risk-peer signal". 4. Test as C30 replacement/augmentation. | 1. Build network on 2010-2020 filings (fixed). 2. Check if risk-peer signal IC > industry-peer signal IC (expanding window). 3. Verify amendment chains preserved (use `accession_number` + `filing_date`). | C30 exists as peer-network mechanism. If risk peers = industry peers, no value. | SEC parsing fails at scale; or risk-peer IC ≤ industry-peer IC after controls. |
| **Foreign-institution info** (cut off) | 13F holdings → foreign ownership % change. Lag: 45 days post-quarter. Use as *slow-moving state* (quarterly), not high-freq signal. | 1. Align 13F dates to trading days (PIT-safe: use `report_date` + 45d). 2. Test if Δforeign_ownership predicts next-quarter returns (expanding window). 3. Check overlap with existing institutional flow signals. | May overlap with existing flow/ownership factors. 45-day lag limits utility. | Lag > 60 days; or predictive power vanishes after controlling for size/value/momentum. |
